entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number 88-Charlie-415.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order. And what's the item you're looking to return?
The jersey. It's the wrong size, just been sitting in the closet. Is it returnable or not?
I see. Okay, and what specifically is the issue with the fit? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I already told you, it's the wrong size. It's way too tight. I want to exchange it, or just get a refund. Look, I don't have all day. Yes or no?
Understood. Apologies. I just need to confirm the delivery date. I'm seeing it was delivered 83 days ago. Let me just verify the return eligibility.
Eighty-three, ninety, whatever. Just tell me if you'll take it back.
Yes, I can confirm. That jersey is a standard item and falls within our 10-day return policy. We can absolutely process that for you.
Great. Finally. So what's the next step? Send me a label.

Of course. I've just authorized the return in our system. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Would you prefer a refund or an exchange for a different size?
Just the refund. Send the label.

Okay, refund it is. The return label has been sent to the email address on your account. You should receive it momentarily. Once we get the jersey back at our warehouse, you'll see the refund process in 3-5 business days.
You're welcome. Is there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thanks for calling VeloFit. Have a good one.
